latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of design-extractor skill for ClawHub.

- Extracts design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, effects) from project style files (.css, .scss, .vue, etc.).
- Automatically generates DESIGN.md with extracted data and awesome-design-md comparison.
- Supports command line and skill-based usage.
- Includes AI cross-platform compatibility info and detailed conversion instructions for Claude Code format.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and a project folder with style files.
